caption: Points and horizontal ranges copy saved worst-end errors and error ranges, converted from fractions to percentage points. Ranges are not confidence intervals. Unavailable errors stay unknown. U is the saved number of unknown external outcomes. An absent seed row means no technically selected cell, not zero error; see the fixed grid. Technical selection is not independent admission. Predictive error alone does not establish a utility or effort advantage; the equally informed direct baseline shares the stated arithmetic. Different source/preparation revisions prevent attribution of cost differences solely to collectors. No averaging, refit or success threshold.
